1.name: Underutilized / Idle
1.description: Asset experiences prolonged inactivity with idle ratios exceeding 70% of clinical deployment time.
1.action_recommendation: Reallocate asset to high-demand units (e.g., ICU, Emergency) or return to central pool.

2.name: Overutilized / High Wear
2.description: High continuous operating hours with minimal idle time. High mechanical wear and bottleneck risk.
2.action_recommendation: Rotate asset with standby inventory to prevent premature component breakdown; schedule preventative calibration.

3.name: High Turnaround / Rapid Relocation
3.description: Frequent inter-departmental transfers, rapid turnaround (< 2h), and surge emergency utilization.
3.action_recommendation: Ensure battery readiness protocols and dual-QR transit tracking remain strictly logged.

0.name: Optimal / Balanced
0.description: Consistent clinical utilization aligned with departmental procedure quotas and maintenance schedules.
0.action_recommendation: Maintain current deployment protocol. Routine biomedical checkups suffice.
